name: scos-memory-fabric
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the SCOS Memory Fabric's mcp-gateway service over HTTPS.
long_description: Bridges Claude Desktop (which only launches local stdio MCP servers) to the SCOS gateway's remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, fronted by cloud-control-plane. Exposes scos_recall, scos_status, scos_explain, scos_user_model, scos_memory_graph, scos_correct and scos_forget against the same backend Claude Code connects to via docs/agent-connection-guide.md. Requires network reachability to the hosted gateway (a public HTTPS endpoint, no VPN needed) and your own per-user API key.

gateway_url.title: SCOS gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Public MCP endpoint, fronted by cloud-control-plane. Defaults to the hosted fleet deployment.

bearer_token.title: SCOS API key
bearer_token.description: Your own per-user API key (scos_live_...) from the SCOS portal, or the SCOS_BEARER_TOKEN value in ~/.hermes/scos.env on this machine.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID (legacy, optional)
tenant_id.description: No longer required -- derived from the API key. Leave blank.

principal_id.title: Principal ID (legacy, optional)
principal_id.description: No longer required -- derived from the API key. Leave blank.
